messages:
Marta: hey team  heads-up: PR #578 touches the Console tracehook docs to make the examples shorter + add locale-friendly number formatting in the cost widget sample. requesting quick review. https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs/pull/578 :mag_right:

Ibrahim: on it. do we need both js + go examples? could keep one and link to SDK reference to reduce maintenance.

Marta: i'd prefer keep js (most users) and a tiny go snippet showing the trace tag call. both are <10 lines.

Noah: quick nit: the cost sample injects `cost_cents` as int in the trace metadata; our Console cost calculator expects dollars as float. we should show `cost_usd = cost_cents / 100.0` in the snippet.

Jia: also the link to the dashboard example points to `/dashboards/legacy/cost` which is deprecated. change to `/console/observability/dashboards/cost-breakdown`. i'll push a small link fix.

Marta: perfect, thanks. i've updated the JS snippet to format in USD and added a 1-line migration note for legacy dashboards. small go snippet below:

```go
// minimal tracehook usage (go sdk)
trace := sdk.NewTraceHook()
trace.AddMetric("cost_usd", float64(cost_cents)/100.0)
trace.AddMetric("lat_ms", elapsedMs)
```

Noah: looks good. can we shorten the JS example further? users get confused by too many helper functions.

Marta: pruned it to core steps: init hook, add metrics, emit. kept a comment pointing to batching tradeoffs.

render-bot: docs CI: linkcheck passed; lint found line>120 in docs/observability/traces.md: please wrap or shorten.

Ibrahim: easy wrap, i'll tidy. also spotted an i18n issue: `en-US` number formatting used in example, maybe change to `Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(cost_usd)` and call out default is user's browser locale.

Marta: good call. added a one-liner about `Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {style: 'currency', currency: 'USD'})` and said teams should swap currency code for local deployments.

Noah: approving once the go snippet uses `AddMetric` (not `SetTag`) and the link is updated.

Marta: thanks all  merging after the lint wrap and Jia's link patch. i'll post a short note in #product-docs when live and attach a screenshot of the Console cost widget next to the single-span trace view. :sparkles:
